Your first digital product can cost $0 and takes four days. Most people think they need money, software, ads or a logo first. What you're really spending is your time. The order: Day 1: Go to Gumroad and type in your idea (what you already know). A page with real sales and real reviews is proof buyers exist. Day 2: Read what those buyers wrote. Their words become the first line of your page. Day 3: Make the smallest version for one specific person: a checklist, planner or short guide. With AI this takes a few hours. Day 4: Show it to someone who isn't a friend or family, post it where they hang out, answer their questions, then change the one thing that stopped them (title, first line or price). Nobody knows what your product will earn until it's in front of the right people. But this order stops you wasting months on something nobody asked for. That's why I teach $27 and up: the higher the price, the fewer people you need.
